description: Minecraft mod reworked hunger to reward food diversity. Crave one food for double nutrition; overeating reduces gains.

mods.name: Crave & Feast
mods.description:
Adds a dynamic craving system that rewards players for eating a variety of foods.
Every player has one food they currently crave — consuming it grants double nourishment,
while eating the same food repeatedly provides diminishing returns.
Perfect for survival worlds where you want eating to feel meaningful and diverse.
